simple_types.name: aHttpClientID
simple_types.code: type aHttpClientID is new integer range 1..integer(getFDSetSize);

simple_types.name: aHttpRequestType
simple_types.code: type aHttpRequestType is ( unknown, get, head, post );

simple_types.name: aHttpResponseType
simple_types.code: type aHttpResponseType is ( bmp, css, gif, html, jpeg, png, text, xml );

subprograms.name: getHeader
subprograms.code: function getHeader( server : aHTTPServer; client : aHttpClientID ) return unbounded_string

subprograms.name: getWebRequest
subprograms.code: procedure getWebRequest( server : in out aHTTPServer; client : out aHttpClientID )

subprograms.name: putNotFound
subprograms.code: procedure putNotFound( server : in out aHTTPServer; client : aHttpClientID )

subprograms.name: putWebResponse
subprograms.code: procedure putWebResponse( server : in out aHTTPServer; client : aHttpClientID; response : unbounded_string; responseType : aHttpResponseType := html )
